title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain College of the Holy Cross
description: Build an under-21-safe late-night ritual board. Every card needs a currently verifiable destination, a direct source supporting late availability, and a conservative explanation of why it matters near this campus. Do not invent student habits, signature orders, popularity, or current hours. Bars and 21+-only venues are prohibited.

cards.title: Cool Beans
cards.subtitle: Hogan Campus Center
cards.notes: Visit this central campus hub for late-night coffee, smoothies, and milkshakes. It serves as a primary social and study gathering spot for students until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee shop in Hogan Campus Center offering late-night beverages and snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Cool Beans is open until 11 p.m. daily and offers smoothies and milkshakes for late-night cravings.
cards.source_title: Cool Beans | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 7:30 a.m.–11 p.m. and Saturday-Sunday 9 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: Crossroads
cards.subtitle: Hogan Campus Center
cards.notes: Head to the bottom floor of Hogan for late-night grill favorites like chicken fingers and mozzarella sticks. It often hosts student musical performances at 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A social dining hub on the lower level of Hogan Campus Center featuring a late-night grill.
cards.evidence_claim: Crossroads offers late-night dining options and hosts '10-Spot' musical acts at 10 p.m. on Tuesday nights.
cards.source_title: Crossroads | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: The 1843 Grill within Crossroads provides late-night grab-and-go items; check current seasonal hours for exact closing.

cards.title: Boulevard Diner
cards.subtitle: Shrewsbury Street
cards.notes: Experience a classic 1936 Worcester diner known for serving breakfast all day. It is a long-standing destination for students seeking a traditional diner atmosphere after hours.
cards.short_summary: A historic 24-hour diner on Shrewsbury Street serving classic American breakfast and comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boulevard Diner is open 24 hours a day, providing a kitchen that is always open for late-night meals.
cards.source_title: Late Night Eats - Discover Central MA
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily according to local tourism and business listings.

cards.title: Kenmore Diner
cards.subtitle: Franklin Street
cards.notes: Visit this Canal District staple for late-night coffee and traditional diner fare. It is frequently packed during late-night hours with students and locals.
cards.short_summary: A popular diner in the Canal District offering late-night service on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenmore Diner is open late on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday nights starting at 11 p.m. for late-night dining.
cards.access_notes: Open for late-night dining Thursday through Saturday nights starting at 11 p.m.

cards.title: Bocado Tapas Wine Bar
cards.subtitle: Winter Street
cards.notes: Share small plates of Spanish cuisine in a warm atmosphere. The full menu of over 40 tapas is available until midnight on weekends for a more upscale late-night option.
cards.short_summary: A Spanish tapas restaurant in the Canal District serving a full menu late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: Bocado serves its full menu until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Contact Us - Bocado Tapas Wine Bar
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight on Friday and Saturday; until 11 p.m. on other nights.

cards.title: The Fix Burger Bar
cards.subtitle: Grove Street
cards.notes: Build your own custom burger with over 40 toppings or choose a signature 'Fixed-Up' option. This spot is known for its house-made sodas and late-night availability.
cards.short_summary: A specialized burger bar offering custom grinds and house-made sodas until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fix serves burgers and house-made sodas every evening until midnight.
cards.source_title: Late Night Eats - Discover Central MA
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight daily for late-night dining.

cards.title: Antonio's Pizza By The Slice
cards.subtitle: Chandler Street
cards.notes: Grab a quick slice with unique topping combinations at this popular pizza spot. It is a frequent choice for students ordering delivery or visiting late in the evening.
cards.short_summary: A pizza shop known for a wide variety of creative slices and late-night delivery options.
cards.evidence_claim: Antonio's Pizza By The Slice in Worcester offers online ordering and pickup until 11:10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Antonio's Pizza 268 Chandler Street - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Online ordering and pickup available until 11:10 p.m.

cards.title: Wings Over Worcester
cards.subtitle: Kelley Square
cards.notes: Order fresh-made wings and tenders with a variety of sauces. This location in Kelley Square is a staple for late-night chicken cravings and student delivery.
cards.short_summary: A chicken wing and tender specialist offering late-night pickup and delivery in Kelley Square.
cards.evidence_claim: Wings Over Worcester is open for pickup and delivery until 10:45 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for pickup and delivery until 10:45 p.m.

cards.title: Lower Kimball Food Court
cards.subtitle: Kimball Hall
cards.notes: Snag grab-and-go items like burritos, sushi, and chicken wings. It is a convenient spot for students on the go between classes or late-night study sessions.
cards.short_summary: An a-la-carte dining area in Kimball Hall featuring various food stations and grab-and-go options.
cards.evidence_claim: Lower Kimball offers a variety of grab-and-go items and is open until 11 p.m. on weekdays.
cards.source_title: Kimball Main Dining Room | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday until 11 p.m. and Saturday-Sunday until 11 p.m. for student dining.

cards.title: Brooks Common Room Kitchen
cards.subtitle: Brooks Hall
cards.notes: Discover this informal student-led dining alternative where international students often prepare meals late at night. It serves as a unique social space for late-night snacks.
cards.short_summary: A student common room kitchen in Brooks Hall known for late-night informal cooking and socializing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brooks Common Room kitchen is noted as a 'hidden gem' for late-night food between 11 p.m. and 3 a.m.
cards.source_title: The Hidden Gem of Holy Cross Dining - The Spire
cards.access_notes: Accessible to residents of Brooks Hall; informal hours typically between 11 p.m. and 3 a.m.
